events.title: Official Discord Server is Live!
events.summary: Greetings, While we've been optimizing the systems under the hood, we have officially launched our Discord server so you can follow the development process more closely and provide direct feedback.This will be our main hub for reporting bugs, reading patch notes first-hand, accessing devlogs, and chatting with other players. We’ve set up a minimal, straightforward structure for direct communication.Join the community before setting up your shop: 👉 https://discord.gg/SbY9JRRaZ
